name: supern
description: Tiny browser tools. Currently: a daily time-block for distracting sites.

scripts.build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json node_modules web-ext-artifacts CHANGELOG.md SPEC.md .claude .env
scripts.sign: web-ext sign --channel=unlisted --api-key=$AMO_JWT_ISSUER --api-secret=$AMO_JWT_SECRET --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json node_modules web-ext-artifacts CHANGELOG.md SPEC.md .claude .env
scripts.release: npm run sign && npm run install-ext
